metadata.title: Irandaam Thirumurai Corpus v1: A Citation-Grounded Tamil Literary Corpus Release
metadata.description: A structured, provenance-preserving corpus release for Irandaam Thirumurai derived from Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU source pages. The package includes JSONL verse-with-commentary records, JSON Schema, corpus card, datasheet, audit reports, coverage report, checksums, rights/access statement, and reuse commands. Source text is attributed to Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU and may be subject to separate rights.
metadata.notes: This is not an official Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU release or mirror. Preserve TamilVU source attribution and verify reuse permissions for TamilVU-derived text.
